lastAttempt.contractResult: The back_width audit found that pinned GarmentCode treats the field as the posterior share of bust circumference: BodiceBackHalf uses back_width/2 and BodiceFrontHalf divides the remaining (bust - back_width)/2. At each inspected GarmentCode profile's derived bust-level fraction (0.709091–0.719259), Blender 4.4.3 BMesh sections of the bound Glasshouse Siroino shape yield posterior arcs of 21.7288–22.3569 cm; posterior/total ratios are 0.509496–0.511364, overlapping GarmentCode's example ratios of 0.473938–0.52. This supports the parameter's meaning, but target stature is unaccepted and the sources do not declare surface endpoints or an arc protocol, so it remains an unaccepted candidate. The separate Breast-bone-tail plane at 0.849433 height fraction changes the posterior ratio to 0.362023, confirming plane sensitivity. Coverage is 0 accepted, 8 unaccepted candidates, 18 unmapped, and not pattern-fitter safe. Existing neck_w remains unaccepted and armscye_depth remains unmapped. No body YAML, pattern, or 3D garment was generated; visualAppearanceReview remains PENDING. The follow-up hip_back_width audit confirms GarmentCode pants split hip circumference into anterior/posterior shares; sample ratios are 0.514019–0.534905. Six sample-derived hip-height fractions map to 0.495056–0.512633 of Siroino stature, and every horizontal BMesh cut has two closed contours (left/right leg loops), so no pelvic contour or posterior arc can be selected. Hips/UpperLeg rest landmarks do not define a validated surface measurement plane; hip_back_width remains UNMAPPED. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 8 unaccepted candidates, and 18 unmapped; safeToFeedPatternFitter=false. No body YAML, pattern, or 3D garment was generated; visualAppearanceReview remains PENDING. The hip_inclination audit traced GarmentMeasurements definition landmarks hips_side_right and waist_side_right with an X-normal plane. Pinned GarmentCode halves the angle and applies tan(halfAngle) to hip depth for pants/skirt side-seam shaping. GarmentCode examples range 4.0–12.6783 degrees. The Siroino measurement report has no equivalent surface landmark pair; available Hips-to-UpperLeg rig proxies are ±48.6445 degrees and their endpoints lie 0.041057–0.051767 m from the surface, so they are not comparable. The field remains UNMAPPED. GarmentMeasurements GPL-3.0 code was inspected read-only and not copied or installed. Measurement coverage remains 0 accepted, 8 unaccepted candidates, 18 unmapped, and unsafe for the fitter. No body YAML, pattern, or 3D garment was generated; visualAppearanceReview remains PENDING. The read-only BMesh hip-inclination transfer run selected a waist contour at fraction 0.742 with a 39.5772 cm convex-hull perimeter; the existing 360-ray result is 39.7183 cm at the same z=0.856912 m plane (0.1411 cm / 0.3553% difference), which checks perimeter extraction only. The first single-contour transition heuristic selected a 79.141 cm hip candidate at fraction 0.550969 and its rightmost-hull proxy angle is -20.6208 degrees. The target lacks registered GarmentMeasurements topology selections, and right-side identity, anatomical plane equivalence, and axis/sign remain unvalidated; keep hip_inclination UNMAPPED. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 8 unaccepted candidates, and 18 unmapped; safeToFeedPatternFitter=false. No body YAML, pattern, or 3D garment was generated; visualAppearanceReview remains PENDING. The normal measurement-coverage audit now records the BMesh perimeter as a same-plane cross-method check on the waist candidate, while leaving the waist field unaccepted. A read-only FBX vertex-weight check found the Hips and Spine 0.5-weight regions overlap from z=0.79303 to 0.81862 m; the hip contour's rightmost proxy x=0.15249 m lies outside the Hips lateral range +/-0.12766 m. These broad deformation regions do not bind hips_side_right or waist_side_right, so no rig weight group is used as a landmark selection. The GarmentMeasurements female mean template and landmark table were read from revision 04e9197c37197c5b05c1c86abf5ac503864e0d8f; their vertex IDs cannot transfer to Siroino (23,752 versus 8,421 vertices). Uniform stature scaling, X/depth bounding-center translation, Y-up to Z-up conversion, and nearest-surface projection place the four hip/waist side candidates 0.006012-0.011250 m from the Siroino surface. The projected right landmark pair yields 9.2028 degrees, within the example range, but correspondence and sign remain unverified; hip_inclination is now an unaccepted candidate in normal coverage. Coverage is 0 accepted, 9 unaccepted, 17 unmapped, and unsafe for the fitter. No body YAML, pattern, or 3D garment was generated; visualAppearanceReview remains PENDING. Read-only BVH face interpolation shows that uniform-scale projected hips_side_left/right land on vertices weighted 0.957849/0.957094 to UpperLeg_L/R, while projected waist_side_left/right are 0.979619/0.975539 weighted to Hips and 0 to Spine. Thus low surface distances do not preserve semantic region. An alternate full-body-bounds scale produces a 13.9459-degree angle (4.7432-degree change) and 0.031299-0.041260 m projection distances. Keep hip_inclination unaccepted; use target-specific anatomical height correspondence as the next experiment. A target-section height remap mapped template hip and waist heights to the selected Siroino BMesh cuts at fractions 0.550969 and 0.742. It shifted landmarks upward 0.041690-0.125793 m; the right-pair angle changed from 9.2028 to 13.5896 degrees, maximum surface distance rose from 0.011250 to 0.028030 m, and target-side contour proxies remained 0.022513-0.069146 m away. This does not bind anatomical landmarks, so hip_inclination remains unaccepted. Blender 4.4.3 execution used the official archive checksum recorded with the audit. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 9 unaccepted candidates, 17 unmapped, and unsafe for the pattern fitter; no body YAML, pattern, or garment 3D was generated. The same-depth lateral-ray experiment at the section-derived hip and waist planes hit all four landmarks on single-loop BMesh sections with zero plane residual. Signed left/right angles were -14.3011 and +15.0393 degrees (0.7382 degrees absolute difference); ray hits were 0.001890-0.031477 m from the remapped guesses. This is bilateral geometric consistency only: source-depth transfer, anatomical side identity, and angle sign remain unregistered, so hip_inclination stays unaccepted. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 9 unaccepted candidates, 17 unmapped, and unsafe for the fitter; no body YAML, pattern, or garment 3D was generated. The independent hip/waist section-plane offset grid tested all 25 combinations from -0.01 m through +0.01 m. All four lateral rays hit in every combination, but only 15/25 combinations retained one closed loop at both planes: hip cuts at -0.01 m and -0.005 m split into two loops. Within the single-loop combinations, absolute left angles ranged 13.4949-14.3964 degrees, right angles 14.1991-15.1345 degrees, and bilateral spreads 0.6873-0.8047 degrees. This confirms local geometric continuity only; a lower hip plane has no unique contour, and the source template depth, anatomical side identity, and angle sign remain unbound. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 9 unaccepted candidates, 17 unmapped, and unsafe for fitting; no body YAML, pattern, or garment 3D was generated. For both split hip cuts (-0.010 and -0.005 m), ordered BMesh contour loops contained 48 and 54 section vertices per loop. The positive/negative world-X lateral hits matched distinct loop polylines within 0.1 mm; their interpolated weights were predominantly UpperLeg_L (0.888089-0.901831) and UpperLeg_R (0.886337-0.900133), respectively. This ties the split loops to separate leg deformation regions but does not bind GarmentMeasurements' hip landmark to those points, so the measurement remains unaccepted. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 9 unaccepted candidates, 17 unmapped, and unsafe for fitting; no body YAML, pattern, or garment 3D was generated. Direct recomputation on the pinned GarmentMeasurements mean.obj gives signed left/right landmark angles of -9.089242/+9.958843 degrees. The nearest inspected GarmentCode body example is mean_all_tpose at 9.86489 degrees (0.093953-degree difference), while the separately named mean_female body preset is 12.6783 degrees (2.719457-degree difference). Thus the female reference mesh and GarmentCode mean_female parameter are not interchangeable; neither value establishes Siroino surface correspondence. No GarmentMeasurements executable was run or source code copied. Source provenance was checked at the pinned GarmentMeasurements and GarmentCode revisions: upstream README attribution links the GarmentCode non-SMPL body model to GarmentMeasurements; mean.obj and mean_female.obj share 23,752 vertices, 47,500 faces, and identical ordered face-index topology, but differ in coordinates (RMS 0.043029105 m, max component 0.166416228 m). mean_female YAML height matches its mesh within 0.00000012 m. This confirms related model lineage and topology, not identical geometry and not a Siroino mapping. Coverage remains 0 accepted, 9 unaccepted, 17 unmapped; visualAppearanceReview remains PENDING; no body YAML, pattern, or 3D garment was generated.
lastAttempt.nextAction: Run the pinned GarmentMeasurements measurement implementation against the pinned GarmentCode mean_female mesh and indexed female landmarks in a read-only temporary build; compare its geometry-derived hip inclination with the mean_female YAML parameter, keep the Siroino value unaccepted, and do not write body YAML or generate a pattern/3D.

targetSectionHeightMapping.mapping: Map source hips-side landmarks to the current Siroino hip-section selected height and source waist-side landmarks to the current Siroino waist-section selected height; preserve uniform-transfer X/depth guesses, then project to the evaluated shaped body surface.

sameDepthLateralRayMapping.mapping: At each selected Siroino BMesh hip/waist section height, cast from outside the body along world X at the source-template uniform-transfer depth. The sign of the transferred X coordinate selects the side; no anatomical side label is inferred.

sourceTemplateLandmarkGeometry.coordinateFrame: GarmentMeasurements mean.obj coordinates; X lateral, Y up, Z depth

surfaceCandidate.rigWeightGroupInterpretation: Weight groups are broad deformation regions, not registered anatomical landmarks. At threshold 0.5, Hips spans world z 0.63566-0.81862 m and Spine spans 0.79303-0.88496 m; their vertical overlap is 0.79303-0.81862 m. The hip rightmost-hull proxy x=0.15249 m falls outside the Hips 0.5-weight lateral bounds -0.12766 to 0.12766 m. These regions do not bind hips_side_right or waist_side_right.
